essence: Initiation is classified into an external action-based form and an internal piercing-based form.
Initiation simultaneously effects inner action-purification and outer purification.
A Kaula practitioner cannot be released without both purifications.
One should bring about for oneself the initiation of the beginningless Kula Kuṇḍalinī.
The initiation depends on the shared intention of the teacher and the excellent disciple.
